ambiguous.title: Ambiguous Result
ambiguous.description: True if multiple records were found in a find/search operation.

ambiguousRelationship.title: Ambiguous Relationship
ambiguousRelationship.description: True if a parent lookup found multiple matches.

ambiguousRelationshipType.title: Ambiguous Relationship Type
ambiguousRelationshipType.description: The type of relationship that has multiple matches.

availableFieldsJson.title: Available Fields JSON
availableFieldsJson.description: JSON string containing metadata for all available fields.

caseSummaryData.title: Case Summary Data
caseSummaryData.description: Comprehensive JSON containing both case details and email thread for summarization. Structure: { caseInfo: {subject, status, priority, description, account, contact, createdDate, lastModifiedDate}, emailThread: [{date, from, to, direction, subject, body}], actionItems: [suggested actions based on emails] }. Use this to provide a complete briefing: TL;DR, current status, communication history, and recommended next steps.

confirmationRequired.title: Confirmation Required
confirmationRequired.description: True if this is a confirmation request for delete operation.

emailCount.title: Email Count
emailCount.description: Total number of email messages found on this case. If greater than 10, only the most recent 10 are included in emailSummaryJson.

emailSummaryJson.title: Email Summary JSON
emailSummaryJson.description: JSON array containing the most recent email messages related to this case. Each email includes: subject, messageDate, fromAddress, toAddress, direction (Inbound/Outbound), and bodySnippet (truncated text). Use this data to summarize the communication history for the user. Present as a TL;DR with key points and potential action items.

enrichmentSuggested.title: Enrichment Suggested
enrichmentSuggested.description: True if additional fields are suggested.

errorMessage.title: Error Message
errorMessage.description: If success is false, this contains a user-friendly error message.

message.title: Message
message.description: Human-readable message describing the operation result.

moreResultsAvailable.title: More Results Available
moreResultsAvailable.description: True if the search returned the maximum number of results but there are more matching records available.

objectType.title: Object Type
objectType.description: The Salesforce object type, always "Case" for Case operations.

previewData.title: Preview Data
previewData.description: A JSON string representation of what would be created/updated.

previewOnly.title: Preview Only
previewOnly.description: True if this is a preview response.

record.title: Record
record.description: The Case record (for single record operations).

recordId.title: Record ID
recordId.description: The Salesforce ID of the record.

records.title: Records
records.description: List of Case records (for bulk or find operations).

relationshipCandidatesJson.title: Relationship Candidates JSON
relationshipCandidatesJson.description: JSON array of candidate records when ambiguousRelationship is true.

suggestedFields.title: Suggested Fields
suggestedFields.description: List of commonly-used field API names.

totalMatches.title: Total Matches
totalMatches.description: Number of Case records found in a find/search operation.
